guitar.guitaristsText: Phil Collen / Vivian Campbell (formerly Steve Clark)
guitar.modelsText: Jackson / Ibanez (Phil Collen signature Jackson PC1)
guitar.evidence: Phil Collen has a long-running Jackson PC1 signature model; Steve Clark (original guitarist) was known for Gibson Les Paul/Jackson.
guitar.notes: Filled from unknown with reasonably well documented info.

tone.target: bright 80s hard-rock crunch with chorus sheen
tone.profile: bright 80s hard-rock crunch with chorus sheen
tone.summary: A tight signal chain using a British high-gain amp model (UK SLP) combined with Chorus and a powerful distortion to achieve the characteristic bright, chorused rhythm sound of Def Leppard's 'Rock of Ages'.

rig.name: Def Leppard - Rock Of Ages - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and tighten the rhythm parts.
Slightly push the signal into the distortion stage for added punch and sustain.
blocks.gap: Using Boost as a general tone shaper/pre-drive, since specific OD models might muddy the tight crunch.

blocks.purpose: Provide the necessary tight, mid-scooped crunch and aggressive edge required for 80s hard rock.
blocks.gap: RAT-style provides a classic, punchy overdrive that fits the era's crunchy tone better than pure fuzz or Muff-style.

blocks.purpose: Apply the signature stereo chorus sheen and width to the rhythm guitars.
Simulate the bright, punchy British high-gain tone characteristic of 80s arena rock.
blocks.gap: UK SLP is chosen for its classic British voicing and ability to handle tight rhythm tones.

blocks.purpose: Provide the necessary physical cabinet voicing and punch for layered rhythm parts.
blocks.gap: The 4x12 is standard for this genre; UK Vintage provides a balanced, bright sound.

blocks.purpose: Sculpt the tone by slightly boosting mids and highs while tightening up the low end to maintain clarity in layered parts.
blocks.gap: Manual EQ adjustment is crucial for achieving the 'tight mid-scooped crunch' sound.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle depth and space to the overall mix without sounding overly wet or distracting from the tight rhythm.
blocks.gap: A moderate Room reverb adds necessary 'arena' size without resorting to excessive gated effects.

improvements.summary: Enhance cabinet realism and brightness for layered 80s hard rock parts.

proposals.reason: Boost the characteristic bright, punchy voicing needed for chorused rhythm guitars.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased clarity and definition in layered parts.
